input_files: current PubMed-indexed systematic reviews, meta-analyses, randomized trials, and safety reviews
generated_from.review_note: Second batch-first structured research enrichment program covering Waves 51-100. The batch contains 79 net-new evidence rows plus 6 reviewed same-identity evidence corrections; duplicate source identities already present before this batch were removed. Findings preserve null/mixed outcomes, formulation/species/strain identity, deficiency/population boundaries, safety/interaction signals, citation integrity, and product-specific evidence.

policy.evidence_merge: append-only by default; targeted same-entity/same-source replacement only when corrects_evidence_key, expected_prior_evidence, and correction_reason are present and validated
policy.claim_calibration: preserve negative/null evidence, uncertainty, endpoint discordance, strain/species/formulation identity, deficiency and disease-population boundaries, safety interactions, source mismatches, and biomarker-vs-clinical distinctions; evidence_grade and safety_note must survive public claim/profile export
policy.verification_strategy: batch-first; expensive repository-wide verification deferred until the complete Waves 51-100 batch is frozen
